correctness.rationale: The 2×2×6 ideals have a bijective four-height enumeration; its 336 masks match an independent predecessor-closure BFS. All 2324 character masks of weight 1–3 are directly signed-summed: no cancellations of weight ≤2 and precisely 32 of weight 3; the 32 match eight explicit four-element coordinate-symmetry orbits. The 24-bit integer Walsh butterfly, checked against 8192 direct character sums and both Parseval/inversion identities, gives exactly 1,414,094 zeros, rank 15,363,122 and positive spectral gap 2. The second full transform of the frequency support has exact absolute sum 9,182,696,964; translating/averaging arbitrary projections proves endpoint optimality without an invariance restriction. Smaller widths 1–5 are exhaustively checked for the bounded first-occurrence claim.

value.rationale: The box poset is canonical (the first 2×2×n three-dimensional plane-partition family), and the 2×2×6 member is the first through width six where every degree-one/two input Fourier character is recoverable but third-degree information is lost. Its 32 geometrically classified cubic blind characters supply a meaningful exact finite boundary, while the independently determined full rank and optimal endpoint norm quantify lost dimensions and the sharp amplification necessary to project arbitrary data onto recoverable signals. These are natural invariants tied to the familiar plane-partition/lozenge ensemble, not a hand-picked parameter slice or routine restatement of its cardinality. The contribution is explicitly finite and does not claim a new general transform or projection lemma.
